component.name: OpenDisplay Receiver
component.summary: Use this screen as an extra display for another computer

description.p: OpenDisplay Receiver turns this screen into an extra display for a Mac or a Linux desktop running the OpenDisplay sender. The sender's desktop extends onto this screen over the local network; this machine's mouse and touchpad work on it too.
The receiver advertises itself on the network, fills the screen when a sender connects, draws the sender's pointer and decodes H.264 in hardware where the system offers it.
First beta of the Linux receiver.
